results.title: Model predictive variable impedance control towards safe robotic interaction in unknown disturbance-rich environments
results.abstract: An adaptive robust and passive model-predictive variable-impedance scheme estimates unknown environment contact parameters online, switches impedance according to safety thresholds, and was evaluated on two silicone models and a human arm under bounded unpredictable position shifts, including robotic ultrasound scanning.
